issues.title: Typhoon Narra stalls offshore as floods batter northern Vietnam
issues.title_en: Typhoon Narra stalls offshore as floods batter northern Vietnam
issues.summary: HANOI: Typhoon Narra, designated as Storm No.4 in Vietnam, stalled off the northern coast early Monday (Aug 24), dumping torrential rain that pushed several rivers to their highest flood-alert levels, killed at least one person and damaged more than 4,000 homes in the northern province of Lang Son.
